situation (example wording): "murders in Philadelphia", "robbery by weapon type in Philadelphia", "DUI arrests nationally", "murder rate in Houston per 100K"
what the app does today: A question with no period asks which period (P05, P06, P37, R13, D31): single figures and breakdowns ask; series default only in some forms (P161 for a Homicide Reports victim or offender breakdown).
proposed behavior: No period named is EVERY YEAR BY YEAR (the P161 rule for every question and every source): one row per year of the data for that source and place, with the note "No years were given, so every year in the data is shown: FIRST through LAST." and buttons for a single year. A question that names a period is unchanged. "Last year" and similar words keep P07. The years are those the source has for the place and measure; NIBRS series over several years follow P158 (the question of all reporting agencies or the Consistent Reporting Agencies for a state or national figure).
exact default or choices offered: Note and buttons for a single year (the latest complete year first).
why: Jeff 2026-11-21 (typed, through the coordinator): no period named = every year by year, not the latest complete year; P161's rule extended to all questions. Supersedes the ask of P05, P06 (single figure) and P37 where no period is named.
status: Decided 2026-11-21 (Jeff, through the coordinator); not built yet
test cases: Not built: tests come with the build.
